recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-style album cover featuring a central hexagonal photographic window framed by intricate geometric line art and halftone dot patterns, set against a saturated yellow field with bold, stylized Western-inspired typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic subject framed by a geometric border
High-contrast color blocking between yellow, red, and blue
Juxtaposition of organic outdoor photography with rigid graphic patterns
Hierarchical text stacking above the central image
coreInvariants: Hexagonal or diamond-shaped central photo crop
Western-style display type with slab serifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man with a guitar is centered within a hexagonal frame, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized red and brown title text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title -> Artist Name -> Tracklist -> Central Image -> Bottom Border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant yellow margins on the left, right, and top edges create a clean, framed look.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red and Chocolate Brown (Primary Title)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan Blue (Secondary Title and Border Accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues with a warm, sun-drenched photographic tone.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses heavy, blocky slab serifs with decorative notches
Artist name uses ultra-condensed, tall sans-serif with internal inline details
Sub-text uses clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand with a distinct blue and red split
Tall, narrow 'R' and 'N' in the artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Decorative Western display paired with ultra-condensed modernism.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy Western slab serif feel of the main title.
Matches the condensed, tall proportions of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid yellow background. In the center, place a hexagonal mask containing a 1960s-style photograph of a man with an acoustic guitar in a sunny outdoor setting. Surround the hexagon with a border of yellow halftone dots and cyan geometric line art patterns.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold Western slab-serif text in red and brown at the top. Below that, add ultra-condensed blue text. Place a small line of all-caps sans-serif text just above the image frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated yellow?
Is the photo contained within a hexagonal or diamond shape?
Are there halftone dot patterns in the border?
Is the typography centered and vertically stacked?

adjustableVariables: Shape of the central photo mask
Specific geometric patterns in the corners
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern logos are present
Verify the halftone dots are visible but not overwhelming
Check that the text colors match the 1960s palette
Confirm the man's attire and guitar style are period-appropriate
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Yellow Field + Hexagonal Photo Mask + Halftone Border + Western/Condensed Type Stack.
